component.name: FTX for Linux
component.summary: FT8 and FT4 for TCI radios

description.p: A native GTK4/libadwaita FT8 and FT4 program for Linux. The decoders are ported by hand from WSJT-X (v3.0.2) to C and are bit-exact against the original: a-priori decoding, multipass signal subtraction and the complete 77-bit message set. The radio is reached over TCI (sdr-for-linux, icom-for-linux): audio both ways and keying on one WebSocket connection.
One window: a labelled waterfall, the Band activity and Rx frequency lists operators know from WSJT-X, and a QSO panel built around the one line that matters — what goes on the air next and when.

First release. FT8 and FT4 decoders ported from WSJT-X v3.0.2 to C, bit-exact against the original (a-priori decoding, multipass subtraction, the complete 77-bit message set), decoding in stages during the period as WSJT-X does. The window works a TCI radio: labelled waterfall, Band activity and Rx frequency lists with the station's country, a QSO panel with the WSJT-X auto-sequencer, transmitting over TCI with WSJT-X's waveform and timing, Tune, a band switcher with the WSJT-X working frequencies that puts the radio into DIGU, and logging to log-for-linux over the WSJT-X UDP protocol with worked-before marks per band and mode. CLI tools ftx-decode, ftx-rx and ftx-record.
